title: pact.decisions
description: Canonical wire schema for the pact.decisions Kafka topic, mirroring internal/kafka/producer.go DecisionEvent. Field names and required/optional status are frozen per ENGINEERING.md - pact-audit pins this shape. additionalProperties is false at every level so an accidental field rename or addition fails validation instead of silently passing through as unrecognised JSONB.

event_uuid.description: Autopopulated by PublishDecision when the caller leaves it empty; always present on the wire.

session_id.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the bearer token - never the token itself.

decision.description: Closed set - pipeline.DecisionKind (internal/pipeline/types.go) only ever produces these two values.

reason.description: Free-form diagnostic reason string (e.g. filter_hostile, classifier_tagged, external_ref_blocked). Open set by design - new reason codes are added without a schema change; engine attribution is derived from the reason prefix, not enumerated here.

engine.description: Closed set derived from the reason-prefix switches in check.emitDecisionEvent, proxy.emitProxyDecisionEvent, and middleware.auditCheckRejections: filter, classifier, consensus, redactor, policy, sandbox (check-path indirect-injection block), gateway (pre-pipeline rejection, e.g. body-too-large, decode failure) and cel (tier-3 CEL rule escalated allow to block).

stages.description: Ordered names of the pipeline stages whose run was invoked for this request, including stages that wrote no sub-object (a pass-through stage, a consensus skipped by threshold). Open set by design - the gateway pipeline owns the stage vocabulary (today: policy, filter, classifier, compliance, sandbox, consensus, redactor, cel), so a new stage needs no schema change. Additive - absent on events produced before the field existed.

traffic_source.description: Caller-declared attribution of synthetic vs real traffic (e.g. "benchmark"). This is attribution, not authorization - it carries no access-control weight and must never be used to grant or deny a request. Omitted entirely when the caller did not declare a traffic source.

contentRef.description: Hash reference to the request content. Absent on requests whose body was never decoded (e.g. pre-pipeline rejections).

sha256.description: Hex-encoded SHA-256 of the request content.

controlRef.description: One compliance control a stage verdict enforces. Open set by design - new frameworks or control IDs are added without a schema change.

framework.description: Compliance framework identifying the control vocabulary, e.g. "owasp_llm_top10" (control IDs "LLM01".."LLM10") or "eu_ai_act_art15" (control IDs "accuracy", "robustness", "cybersecurity"). Open set by design - decisions.FrameworkOWASPLLMTop10 and decisions.FrameworkEUAIActArt15 are the two known values today.

id.description: Framework-specific control identifier, e.g. "LLM01" under owasp_llm_top10 or "accuracy" under eu_ai_act_art15.

matchedSpan.description: Byte-range within the filter's normalized input that triggered a block decision. start/end index the NORMALIZED (lowercased/preprocessed) input, not the original content.

excerpt.description: Bounded, redactor-masked copy of the matched substring - never the full content.

causalSpan.description: One byte-range in the ORIGINAL request content that the gateway's M12 causal replay identified as contributing to a block decision. Text is deliberately omitted (PII avoidance).

decisionDiagnostics.description: Causal-replay diagnostics. Present only on block decisions when the gateway's M12 causal replay ran (PACT_DIAGNOSTICS_ENABLED) and span capture is enabled.

verdict.description: Closed set per pipeline.Decision.FilterVerdict doc comment (internal/pipeline/types.go).

shadow.description: True when the match was a dry-run shadow rule.

controls.description: Compliance controls this stage verdict enforces, stamped by the gateway from its static per-stage control table. Additive - empty or absent on events produced before the mapping existed.

pack_name.description: Name of the loaded rule pack the verdict was produced under. Open set - the rule-pack publisher owns the vocabulary. Additive - absent on events produced before the field existed.

pack_version.description: Version of the loaded rule pack the verdict was produced under. Open set - the rule-pack publisher owns the vocabulary. Additive - absent on events produced before the field existed.

duration_ms.description: Deprecated in favour of duration_us. Wall-clock milliseconds the gateway spent in this stage for this request; truncates sub-millisecond stages to 0. Will be removed no earlier than the next minor after consumers move. Additive - absent on events produced before the field existed.

duration_us.description: Wall-clock microseconds the gateway spent in this stage for this request. A producer stamps a value >= 1 for every stage that executed (a sub-microsecond run rounds up), so presence means measured. Additive - absent on events produced before the field existed and on stages that did not run.

label.description: Model-reported label. Open set by design - pact-classifier owns the label vocabulary and can add heads without a gateway schema change.

engine.description: Free-form model/checkpoint tag (e.g. stub-v1, deberta-prompt-injection-v2@abcd1234). Open set - mirrors classifierpb.ClassifyResponse.model_version.

windows.description: Number of token windows the classifier inspected, copied from ClassifyResponse.windows. Input longer than the model window is scanned as overlapping windows. Additive - absent when the engine did not report a count.

consensusDecision.description: Present only when classifier_score < PACT_CONSENSUS_THRESHOLD (stage 2.5 ran).

quorum_reached.description: No omitempty on the Go field - always present within an emitted consensus object, even when false.

mode.description: Present only when the vote ran as a background completion off the /v1/check hot path; absent (not "inline") when the vote ran inline - kafka.ConsensusDecision.Mode is only ever set to "shadow".

skipped_reason.description: Machine-readable cause of skipped=true: consensus_timeout, consensus_error (shadow-mode vote failures), consensus_saturated (pact-consensus shed the vote with RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED), or shadow_saturated (shadow-mode completion pool full). Open set by design, and not populated on the pre-existing inline-mode transport-error fail-open (skipped=true with no reason) to keep that path's wire output unchanged.

complianceDecision.description: The gateway's deferred shadow stage: the (system prompt, user message) pair scored via pact-classifier's CheckCompliance RPC, recorded advisory-only, never enforced. Present only when the compliance stage was invoked for this request. Additive - absent on every event produced before the compliance stage existed.

shadow.description: Always true today - the compliance stage is advisory-only, never enforced.

verdict.description: The engine's thresholded call: "compliant" when the message stays within the system prompt's instructions, "deviating" when it attempts to deviate from or override them. Absent when skipped is true - the RPC never returned a verdict to threshold.

score.description: The engine's probability in [0.0, 1.0] that the user message DEVIATES from the system prompt. Higher = riskier. Copied from CheckComplianceResponse.score.

model_version.description: Engine + checkpoint identity (e.g. deberta-compliance-v1@abcd1234), copied from CheckComplianceResponse.model_version. Open set - pact-classifier owns the checkpoint vocabulary.

skipped.description: True on a transport-error, timeout or load-shed fail-open: the CheckCompliance RPC failed, did not return in time or was refused by the saturated classifier, so the request proceeded with no compliance verdict recorded. skipped_reason names the cause when it is known.

skipped_reason.description: Machine-readable cause of skipped=true: classifier_saturated (pact-classifier shed the call with RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED) and oversize_tokens (the pair exceeded the model input budget; pact-classifier rejected it with INVALID_ARGUMENT and an ErrorInfo reason of oversize or oversize_tokens). Open set by design, and not populated on the transport-error or timeout fail-open (skipped=true with no reason) or on events produced before the field existed.

windows.description: Number of token windows the classifier inspected, copied from CheckComplianceResponse.windows. Input longer than the model window is scanned as overlapping windows. Additive - absent when the engine did not report a count.

verdict.description: Closed set per pipeline.Decision.PolicyVerdict doc comment. The empty string is also a valid pipeline value (skipped - no token presented) but that case never constructs a policy sub-object at all, so it never appears on the wire.

tool_mitigation_mode.description: Closed set per pipeline.Decision.ToolMitigationMode doc comment. The empty string is also valid but is dropped by omitempty, so it never appears on the wire.

requested_tool_id.description: The tool id the /v1/check caller declared the request was for. Compared with the validated token's tool_id; a mismatch blocks with reason policy_token_scope_denied. Open-set plain string. Additive - absent on events produced before the field existed and when the caller declared nothing.

requested_scope.description: The scope the /v1/check caller declared the request needed. Compared with the validated token's scopes; a scope the token does not carry blocks with reason policy_token_scope_denied. Open-set plain string. Additive - absent on events produced before the field existed and when the caller declared nothing.

spotlightDecision.description: Present when spotlight_chunks were wrapped, or when stripping was detected in an output check.

source_count.description: No omitempty on the Go field - always present within an emitted spotlight object; 0 is distinct from absent.

marker_in_output.description: True when a kind=output content check contained the spotlight closing-marker prefix.

source.description: Caller-supplied provenance tag for the reference (e.g. rag:1, tool:web). Open set - defined by the /v1/check caller, not the gateway.

externalRefDecision.description: Indirect-injection sandbox result. Present only on the check path when the request declared external references and the sandbox ran; the proxy path never sets this.

routingDecision.description: Which upstream served a proxied request. Set only on the proxy output-scan event, after a successful forward; never carries base_url or an API key.

upstream_id.description: Stable per-account upstream id; empty means the global fallback upstream.

provider.description: Admin-configured upstream provider tag (e.g. openai, openai-compatible). Open set - operators can register arbitrary provider names.

celDecision.description: Decisive tier-3 CEL rule outcome. Present only when the CEL stage ran and either at least one active rule fired or the stage recorded a skip reason - a stage that ran and evaluated zero rules to true, with no budget exhaustion, is omitted entirely.

outcome.description: Closed set - celeval.Outcome* constants. Only "block" ever escalates decision/reason; "redact" and "log" are audit-only (CEL runs after the redactor stage, so there is nothing left to redact).

fired_count.description: Total number of active rules whose expression evaluated to true, which may exceed 1 even though only the decisive (highest-severity) rule is named above.

skipped_reason.description: Closed set - celeval.SkipReason* constants. Present only when the stage could not fully evaluate every active rule (fail-open): cel_stage_timeout/cel_rule_timeout are budget exhaustion, cel_rule_error covers both a CEL runtime error and an expression that evaluated cleanly to a non-boolean value. Absent when every active rule was attempted regardless of outcome.

contentDelivery.description: Deterministic reference to an asynchronous tenant-custody content delivery. Present only on block decisions whose capture tier is redacted_full with a configured sink; a reference for tenant-side correlation - PACT persists no content. Generated at decision time, before delivery to tenant-owned storage completes.

content_sha256.description: SHA-256 hex of the redacted payload as delivered.
